jpl_regional_comparison.scope: Three selected real NASA DEM cells; three hourly epochs per cell and target; one departure date. This does not validate every location, epoch, lunar reference-frame realization, terrain horizon, or mission scenario.

jpl_height_comparison.scope: Five epochs per body and one point. Direct JPL observer queries independently check the polar-reference translation and heights. This does not validate all dates, terrain, spacecraft or the lunar frame with SPICE.

regional_implementation_parity.scope: same inputs in Python/JavaScript; consistency, not independent physical validation
